note: The sample is a handful of pools that were trending or new when the backtest ran, with at most 1000 five-minute bars (about 3.5 days) from GeckoTerminal. Pools that already died are absent, so this is survivorship-biased. Liquidity is today's snapshot applied to every historical bar; past slippage is not reconstructed. Swap fees come from the pool when it publishes one, otherwise 30 bps per side, plus a fixed per-chain gas estimate. Parameters were set before this run and were not searched. A pass is positive expected value after costs on this sample only. It is not evidence of a durable edge.
